title: Renewal Charge Terms — Domain Registrations
content:
## Domain Registration Agreement — renewal charges of Domain Registrations

**R1 (no longer in force).** "Every renewal of a domain, whether manual, auto-renew or during the renewal grace period, is billed at the TLD's renewal price per year renewed plus the ICANN fee per year, and no late surcharge applies during the grace period." This clause is no longer in force — superseded by the current basis for renewal-type charges of Domain Registrations.

**R2.** A renewal must be for at least the TLD's minimum renewal years, in whole years.

**R3.** The new expiry date is the current expiry date plus the years renewed, never the payment date plus the years, including during the grace period.

**R4.** A renewal is refused if its new expiry date would lie more than the TLD's maximum registration years after today's date.

**R5.** A renewal may be charged only while the domain status is active, on hold or grace.

**R6.** The renewal-price component of every renewal line is reduced by the domain renewal discount percentage that Harborline Customer Accounts sets for the customer's account tier; a manual multi-domain order may instead receive the bulk discount as the multi-domain renewal order rule states; and the ICANN fee is never discounted.

**R7.** Amounts are rounded half up to the cent.

### Basis of R5

The status is read from the system record of the domain holding being renewed, before the renewal is charged.

| Domain status | Renewal may be charged |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| on hold | yes |
| grace | yes |
| redemption, pending delete, deleted, transferred out, cancelled, pending | not under R5 |

### Expiry date and the ceiling — illustration

Hypothetical: a domain whose recorded expiry date is 20 May 2029 is renewed for two years on 2 May 2029. Under R3 the new expiry date is 20 May 2031, counted from the expiry date and not from the day of payment. Under R4 the renewal stands only while that new expiry date lies no more than the TLD's maximum registration years after the day of the renewal; a renewal whose new expiry date would lie beyond that point is refused.

### Points of judgement

- *Does a renewal made in the grace period move the expiry date from the day it is paid?* No. R3 counts from the current expiry date, including during the grace period.
- *Is the ICANN fee ever reduced by an account-tier or bulk discount?* No (R6).

superseded_clauses: Every renewal of a domain, whether manual, auto-renew or during the renewal grace period, is billed at the TLD's renewal_price per year renewed plus the icann_fee_per_year per year, and no late surcharge applies during the grace period.
